draft.persona: Berit Kelpwick is a solid dun arctic wolf with meticulously clean fur and a quiet, even manner. At thirty-eight, she speaks plainly, with a dry joke tucked beneath warm concern. Larkfield still shapes her voice, though years in Ridgemere have softened its market cadence. She keeps the egg stall on the Heights Market, trading in fair-priced goods for wolves richer than she was born. Born in the Sump, she means to die in the Heights, and feels every clean step upward without forgetting the mud below. Rich by trade yet never fully at ease among the great Houses, she gives generously while guarding every coin. She takes the long stairs two at a time, both from habit and stubborn hope.

words: A full-weight egg hatches a fair bargain.

say: Fair-priced eggs, full weight, fresh this morning.
For the Heights, only the best.
Fair price to you, {player}. Come for eggs or news?
Good trade, {player}. Mind the stairs; they bite harder going down.
A rich wolf can still tell a light egg from a full one. That is something.
I was born below the Sump. I know what a fair bargain is worth.
The long stairs are quicker two at a time.
Leave the cleanest shell aside, dear. Tomorrow deserves a proper breakfast.
